sloka: पङ्कदिग्धस्तु भरतो जटिलस्त्वां प्रतीक्षते ।पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्वं च कुशलं गृहे ।। ६.१२७.४ ।।
transliteration: paṅkadigdhastu bharato jaṭilastvāṁ pratīkṣate ।pāduke te puraskṛtya sarvaṁ ca kuśalaṁ gṛhe ।। 6.127.4 ।।

translations.english: "Bharata is without attention to his body, wearing matted locks, placing your wooden sandals in front expecting you in the house. All is well at Ayodhya."
